assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: All geometry uses the provisional rough site/key-area boundaries from the site package; official polygons must replace them and all area metrics must be recomputed before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: Area-based metrics (site/green/public/building) are provisional recomputations, not official figures.

assumptions.statement: The naming connection between the Zhongzhiyuan area and the open-source compute stack 'Zhongzhi' (2025 Bulletin) is an inference; the Bulletin does not state the relationship directly.
assumptions.impact: The proposal phrases it as 'naming echo', not as an official statement.

assumptions.statement: Economic metrics (tech-contract intensity 35,513 CNY/m², lab density 2.11/km²) are district-bulletin derivations over the provisional site/research area; not parcel-level facts.
assumptions.impact: These metrics are background evidence with low confidence, not measured site data.

assumptions.statement: The 11 concept building envelopes are key-area illustrations, not existing or approved buildings; regulatory controls (FAR/height/density/setback) remain unknown.
assumptions.impact: Building footprint and related metrics are conceptual volumes only.

assumptions.statement: Rail-station integration nodes, municipal infrastructure directions, and retain/renovate/demolish classifications depend on official rail/municipal/property-rights surveys.
assumptions.impact: These items are listed as pending confirmation, not design conclusions.

assumptions.statement: The 11 building footprints in geometry/buildings.geojson are agent-generated conceptual massing (source_type=agent_generated_design, confidence=low, role=design_proposal) for design communication only; they are not survey data, ownership evidence, or engineering feasibility conclusions.
assumptions.impact: Building footprints must not be used for demolition/renovation decisions, floor-area computations, or any statutory conclusion until verified against official survey data.
